claim: Patchline ships a standards-body conformance corpus for PLCI/1 certificates where every certificate example has a positive proof, a near-miss negative control, and an Ed25519-signed reference output. The gate validates the frozen corpus manifest, parses every positive proof against real Patchline source/spec/doc files, rejects every negative control for the expected semantic reason, verifies each signed reference output against a pinned public key, and proves signature tampering fails via `make standards-body-conformance-corpus-gate`.
real_repo: patchline (self): cmd/patchline/main.go, internal/repair/proof.go, PLCI grammar, and certificate docs
